notes: Read all 133 numbered source lines before editing. Native port follows the established dashboard idiom (GlancePage / AutomationHistoryWidget): the native RadialGauge charts port is reused, and every not-yet-ported web dependency (WidgetShell, WidgetGaugeHero, DataFreshness, useUnits/unitConversion, numberFormat, react-i18next, lucide-react) is reproduced inline native-safe and documented here.

L1 `import { useMemo }` -> native `import {useMemo}` (plus useEffect/useState for the inline freshness tick). L2 react-i18next useTranslation('dashboard') -> module-level English-default `t(key, fallback, vars?)` with {{var}} interpolation, keeping every widget.batteryHealthAnalytics.* / freshness.* key verbatim.

L3 lucide-react HeartPulse -> no native icon font: the wide-header icon becomes a small emerald (colors.success ≈ emerald-400) '\u2665' HeartGlyph; the EmptyState HeartPulse icon (L106/L126) is dropped (native EmptyState has no icon slot) with the heart signal preserved in the header.

L4 feedback EmptyState -> shared native EmptyState (../../../../components/feedback/EmptyState); web single `message` prop -> native `title`, native `message=''`; the web `className` py-2/py-4 spacing is dropped (no native EmptyState slot).

L5 useBatteryHealthAnalytics imported unchanged from ../../../api/hooks/useEnergy (same /analytics/battery-health?vehicle_id=… path, same BatteryHealthAnalytics snake_case shape: current_soh/total_cycles/full_charge_pct/avg_depth_of_discharge/fast_charge_pct/temp_exposure_score/charge_habits_score).
L6 useVehicles imported unchanged from ../../../api/hooks/useVehicles (same /vehicles path; data?.[0]?.id fallback preserved).

L7 @/hooks/useUnits -> inline `useUnits()` that derives `unitPrefs.temperature` from the native useSettings exactly as web useUnits' deriveTemperature does (unit_of_temp === 'F' -> '\u00b0F' else '\u00b0C'); only temperature is read by this widget so the mirror exposes just that pref (returned via useMemo for reference stability).
L8 @/lib/numberFormat fmtNumber/fmtInt -> inlined verbatim with safeNumber guard, default precision 2, en-US grouping (fmtInt = fmtNumber(v,0)).

L9 './WidgetShell' -> inline `WidgetShell`: loading -> skeleton (testID battery-health-analytics-loading); error -> centred errorBox + retry Pressable mirroring web <QueryError> (testID battery-health-analytics-error); titled -> header (HeartGlyph + uppercase muted title + WidgetFreshness) over body; title-less (compact) -> body with WidgetFreshness overlaid top-right (web absolute top-1.5 right-1.5). Honours exactly the props this widget passes.

L10 './shared' WidgetGaugeHero + GaugeHeroStat -> inline `WidgetGaugeHero` + local `GaugeHeroConfig`/`GaugeHeroStat`: compact size 70 / standard 100 (web parity), the native RadialGauge for the ring, and the flex-wrap stat grid (label + value + optional unit) rendered only when !compact && stats.length>0. Web's unused `children` slot omitted (widget never passes it).

L11 './types' WidgetProps -> local `WidgetProps`/`WidgetSize` (only vehicleId + size.cols read). L12 @/lib/unitConversion convertTempFromSI -> inlined verbatim ('\u00b0C' identity, '\u00b0F' -> *9/5+32).
L14-18 scoreColor(score) ported verbatim: >=80 -> '#10b981', >=50 -> '#f59e0b', else '#ef4444' (passed to RadialGauge color).

L20-21 default export BatteryHealthAnalyticsWidget({vehicleId, size}); useTranslation('dashboard') -> inline t. L22 const {unitPrefs} = useUnits() preserved verbatim. L23 toTemperatureDisplay = (value)=>convertTempFromSI(value, unitPrefs.temperature) preserved.

L25 tempUnit = unitPrefs.temperature; L26 const {data: vehicles} = useVehicles(); L27 vid = vehicleId ?? vehicles?.[0]?.id; L28 vehicleIdStr = vid != null ? String(vid) : null — all preserved verbatim.

L36 isCompact = size.cols <= 1; L37 hasData = !!data; L39 healthScore = data?.current_soh ?? 0; L40 color = useMemo(()=>scoreColor(healthScore),[healthScore]) — preserved.

Companion __tests__/BatteryHealthAnalyticsWidgetParity.test.tsx mocks useBatteryHealthAnalytics/useVehicles/useSettings and renders: loading skeleton, wide-with-data (gauge + all six stats), wide-empty, compact-with-data (title-less, no stats), compact-empty, query-error box, and the vehicleId fallback (first vehicle id passed to the hook). Every test unmounts so the 30s freshness interval leaves no open handle.

Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint .), npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles (jest). No DOM, react-router, framer-motion, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported into the native output.
